summary: fix(passive-indices): retry niftyindices HTML answers on CSV/JSON endpoints; report them as an upstream error, not an auth error
reason: From a server host niftyindices answers about 27% of constituent CSV requests with an HTTP 200 HTML page. The CLI did not retry and reported it as 'not authenticated or session expired', although these endpoints need no auth.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; retry, exhaustion, HTML detection and exit code 9 covered with httptest servers.
